apps.name: Hevy
apps.description: A fast workout log that makes it obvious whether your lifts are progressing or only feeling harder.

apps.name: MacroFactor
apps.description: A nutrition tracker that recalculates targets from your actual intake and weight trend.
GainFrame turns consistent progress photos into estimates and trends that show whether the plan changed your physique.

apps.name: WHOOP
apps.description: A screenless band for lifters whose training volume is high enough that recovery is the actual constraint.

apps.name: Strava
apps.description: The default social log for running and cycling, with routes, segments, and enough peer pressure to get outside.
